data.name: Alyaan
data.gender_notes: Alyaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'a-l-y', meaning 'to rise'. Alyaan is a name given to a boy, symbolizing a gift bestowed by Allah. The name Alyaan carries the meaning “Gift from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alyaan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the qualities of nobility, generosity, and grace.
data.etymology: Alyaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift from Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alyaan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عليان
in_arabic.meaning: عليان: اسم لطيف، فريد، و مميز.
in_arabic.long_meaning: العليان: هو اسم عربي يرمز إلى الصفة التى تميز الفرد عن غيره، وتعني الفردية، التميز، و الفخر. يُشير إلى الجوانب الجيدة للفرد مثل العقل، والصبر، والصادق. كما يُعتبر اسم عليان من الأسماء الشائعة في العالم الإسلامي، وخاصةً في الخليج العربي.

in_urdu.name: علیان
in_urdu.meaning: علیان: ایک لطیف، فریڈ، اور ممتاز نام.
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیان نام ایک لطیف، فریڈ، اور ممتاز نام ہے جو عربیت کا مظاہر کرنے والا ہے۔ یہ نام خاندان کے اعلیٰ درجے سے تعلق رکھتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ہے جو اس کے تعلق کا اظہار کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलयाण
in_hindi.meaning: अलयाण: एक सुंदर, विशिष्ट, और विशिष्ट नाम.
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलयाण नाम एक सुंदर, विशिष्ट, और विशिष्ट नाम है जो अरबी भाषा का प्रतीक है। यह नाम मुस्लिम परिवारों में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, खासकर भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में।

in_pashto.name: عليان
in_pashto.meaning: عليان: يوچي د فريد، د تميز، او د فخرفه.
in_pashto.long_meaning: عليان نام يوچي د فريد، د تميز، او د فخرفه په معنا لري. دا نام په افغانستان کې د خټو خلکو په ميړو کې لوی پرمختګ پيدا کوي. دا نام په افغانستان کې د يو فريد او تميز انسان په معنا لري.

data.cultural_impact: In various Arabic-speaking Muslim communities, the name Alyaan is associated with luminous imagery and nobility, as the continuous rising motion of the sun is a tangible reminder of Allah's power and generosity. Naming a child with this name expresses a desire for them to grow into individuals of tremendous resilience and constant progress in both their personal and communal lives. Furthermore, the name Alyaan reflects the diverse and rich Arabic cultural heritage, which places great emphasis on the connection between the Divine and the human experience.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the name Alyaan infuses a deep spiritual meaning into the identity of the named individual by evoking the concept of personal growth, self-improvement, and the pursuit of greater closeness to Allah through The Five Pillars of Islam. As a name with celestial associations, it is hoped that Alyaan will be inspired and oriented towards seeking knowledge and wisdom, thus attaining higher levels of spiritual awareness and sovereignty (Qiddamah). As a result, through the beautiful and meaningful name Alyaan, parents bestow upon their child a lasting identity rooted in spiritual growth and resilience.
